cleaner.title: Data Cleaner
cleaner.start_cleaning_desc: Upload your dataset to automatically scan and categorize issues such as missing data, wrong types, or duplicate rows.
cleaner.drag_drop_prompt: Drag and drop data file here
cleaner.file_support_hint: or click to browse — supports CSV, XLSX, XLS (max 10MB)

cleaner.confirmed_banner_desc: File cleaned and saved successfully. Ready for Visualization.
